Swiss Army Bench 0.0.9: a fix for 0.0.8.

- **Show is back** on the "In the Sandbox" message after you send a result from the Analyze menu, a tie-out or an
  analysis blade. In 0.0.8 it went missing with the Sandbox tab; it now takes you to the card again.

Update from the tray (right-click, Update to 0.0.9), or:

```powershell
irm https://github.com/DylanCodyBrown/SwissArmyBench/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```
